description: Something like adventure plain but 50% water
notes: 'Like Adventure Plain': Adventurer's Plain (JG01) measured by `mapgen-zone.py profiles`: its terrain character (hilly, median slope 22 degrees) and its decoration density per kind relative to all of Junon.
50% water: the land is flooded to the level that puts half of the play area under water, so the water follows the hills' own low ground (Adventurer's Plain itself is 37% water).

Adventurer's Plain's own village (a harbour village there: piers, port barrels and boxes) is placed by the water. First tries asked for the centre (flooded) and then anywhere 15 m back from the water (no room for a 69 m village with half the map under water). The start is beside it.
name: Mapgen Flooded Plain
